Criterion: Verify that the system design is within acceptable risk bounds over worst-case environmental conditions. Standard: Safety risks due to system exposure/operation in required environmental conditions are defined and verified to be within acceptable limits. Method of Compliance: Verification method includes inspection of documentation. Evidence that the safety risk minimization process addresses effects of worst-case environmental conditions on the design is verified by review of safety analyses and environmental/climatic test results/reports. References: MIL-STD-810 MIL-STD-882 SAE ARP4761 14 CFR Section 1309 of Parts 23, 25, 27, 29 and related advisory circulars.
